readings: Join scanspatial to projects on projects.arcregistry = scanspatial.arcref and group by projects.fundflux, with a missing funding source as its own group. For each group, compute the average of boxy/boxz over the rows where both values are non-null. Define each group's size as the number of scanspatial records in it. Take the average size across the funding-source groups. Among the groups whose size is above that average, return one row with the average of their average ratios, the sum of their sizes, and the average amount by which their sizes exceed the average size. Do not round.

Join scanspatial to projects on projects.arcregistry = scanspatial.arcref and group by projects.fundflux, with a missing funding source as its own group. For each group, compute the average of boxy/boxz over the rows where both values are non-null. Define each group's size as the number of distinct projects (distinct arcregistry) that have scanspatial data in it. Take the average size across the funding-source groups. Among the groups whose size is above that average, return one row with the average of their average ratios, the sum of their sizes, and the average amount by which their sizes exceed the average size. Do not round.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS ff,
         AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL THEN s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz END) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios,
       SUM(g.size) AS total_size,
       AVG(g.size - a.avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.size > a.avg_size;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux,
         AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL THEN s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz END) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios,
       SUM(g.size) AS total_size,
       AVG(g.size - a.avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.size > a.avg_size;
